## What it is
Signal Log is the VaultSpark Studios development journal. It publishes build notes, update logs, studio announcements, and dispatches from inside the forge — behind-the-scenes writing on how games and tools get built at VaultSpark Studios.

## Current focus
Active publishing of build notes and insider dispatches as the studio ships new features and project milestones.

## Next milestone
Ongoing — new entries published as builds and studio moves happen. Subscribe via the Insider Dispatches newsletter to receive new entries directly.
